accepted.speaker: Gatekeeper Sable
accepted.text: The seal is broken. The sovereign has noticed you.

active.speaker: Gatekeeper Sable
active.text: Baltoria waits on the throne. Strike when you are ready.

choices.text: Break the seal. I will face Baltoria.

greet.speaker: Gatekeeper Sable
greet.text: The seal is yours to break. Beyond it waits Baltoria. Few return from that throne.

locked.speaker: Gatekeeper Sable
locked.text: The arena seal holds. Clear the withered grove and return when the castle road is open.

turnin.speaker: Gatekeeper Sable
turnin.text: The throne is silent. Reverie owes you a debt.

victory.speaker: Gatekeeper Sable
victory.text: The castle will keep its secrets a little longer. Travel well.

accepted.speaker: Warden Corvin
accepted.text: The road ahead will tell you what needs doing. Return when it is quiet.

active.speaker: Warden Corvin
active.text: The thornhounds still roam the grove. Two must fall.

after.speaker: Warden Corvin
after.text: The grove breathes again. Speak to Sable at the arena gate.

done.speaker: Warden Corvin
done.text: The castle gate stands ahead. May you not need what waits inside.

greet.speaker: Warden Corvin
greet.text: Thornhounds have claimed the grove. Drive them off and I can break the blight seal.

turnin.speaker: Warden Corvin
turnin.text: You made the road safe. Take this, and go onward.

choices.text: I will speak with the gardener.

greet.speaker: East Gate Guard
greet.text: The old sentinels have stirred near the reflecting pools. The Royal Gardener has been trying to understand what woke them.

greet.speaker: West Gate Guard
greet.text: Welcome to the western promenade. The stone paths are safe, but please keep clear of the reflecting pools.

about.speaker: Edgar
about.text: Edgar. I look after the market here in Greenward. That is enough biography for a first meeting, I think.

greet.speaker: Edgar
greet.text: Welcome. If you are looking for something useful, you have come to the right stall. If you are looking for a bargain, I advise you to lower your expectations.

choices.text: Sounds like a great deal of work.

market.speaker: Edgar
market.text: I keep the stalls in order, settle disputes, and make certain the village has what it needs. A market is more than a place to trade. It is where a village learns to trust itself.

work.speaker: Edgar
work.text: It is. Though I find that keeping accounts is easier than keeping people from arguing over the price of turnips.

accepted.speaker: Elder Maelin
accepted.text: Do not kill what can be calmed. And if you hear the roots whisper your own name — do not answer.

accepted2.speaker: Elder Maelin
accepted2.text: The eastern clearing. Follow the grey moss. And traveler — if it speaks with your voice, it is only remembering how.

after_glade.speaker: Elder Maelin
after_glade.text: The glade is quieter. Not healed — quieter. That is the most honest thing a forest can be.

elder_accepted.speaker: Elder Maelin
elder_accepted.text: Follow the old roots east. The Elder Hollow is no mere beast; it is the memory of Greenward given a body. Bring that memory back to me.

choices.text: I will return with its memory.

elder_in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
elder_in_progress.text: The First Tree waits in the eastern wood. Follow the roots that break through the old stones, and be ready for what remembers you.

elder_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
elder_reward.text: The trail leads to the ruined conservatory. The Matron is no longer its keeper. End the corruption before it takes root in another heart.

greet.speaker: Elder Maelin
greet.text: You walked out of the mist like you were expected. Sit. The glade has been speaking in its sleep, and I do not like the words.

choices.text: I will return when it is done.

hollow_in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
hollow_in_progress.text: The Hollowed Guardian still stands between us and the truth. Return when you have ended its watch.

choices.text: I will seek the First Tree.

hollow_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
hollow_reward.text: Greenward will remember what you have done. The old paths are quiet for now, but the First Tree has begun to remember. Its oldest heart lies deeper in the eastern wood.

choices.text: I will return when it is done.

in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
in_progress.text: Three mosslings. Listen for the ones whose moss has gone grey — they are the ones dreaming too loudly.

lore_maelin.speaker: Elder Maelin
lore_maelin.text: A gardener, once. Now I keep the stories the trees forget. The young ones call me Elder because I am the only one who still remembers their names.

matron_accepted.speaker: Elder Maelin
matron_accepted.text: The ruined conservatory lies south of the old stones. Do not mistake her sorrow for mercy.

matron_in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
matron_in_progress.text: The Fallen Matron waits in the ruined conservatory. End the corruption, then come back to me.

matron_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
matron_reward.text: Take this final gift. When you are ready, the roads beyond Greenward will open. There are more stories than this forest can hold.

quest2_intro.speaker: Elder Maelin
quest2_intro.text: It was the first tree of Greenward. Now it is a wound with bark around it. End its watch, and bring me what sleeps inside. Do not let it keep dreaming.

quest_intro.speaker: Elder Maelin
quest_intro.text: The mosslings no longer sleep. They walk in patterns that spell a name I have not heard in three hundred years. Calm three of them, and I will tell you what the roots are dreaming.

quest_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
quest_reward.text: Take these. Moonpetals for the road, and a bow that still remembers being a branch. The Guardian will not come to us. You will have to go to it.

choices.text: Then I will find the Matron.

turnin_elder.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_elder.text: You faced the First Tree and returned. The memory you carried is not a warning. It is a name: the Matron. She was the keeper who first tried to bind the corruption.

turnin_glade.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_glade.text: You calmed them. Good. But the dream did not stop — it only turned over. The Hollowed Guardian at the eastern edge has taken root in something that is not soil.

choices.text: I brought what you asked for.

turnin_hollow.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_hollow.text: You have ended the Guardian’s watch. The roots can finally rest. Give me a moment; there is something I would have you carry from this place.

turnin_matron.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_matron.text: The glade is quiet. Not healed, perhaps, but free to grow again. You have done more than any of us dared ask.

greet.speaker: Grove Keeper Thalen
greet.text: This tree remembers the first dawn. The blight is not born here; it is being called from the ruins. If you hear your name among the branches, do not answer.

lore.speaker: Grove Keeper Thalen
lore.text: The Royal Road binds these places together. Each landmark is part of an older warding path, and the stones remember what the living have forgotten.

caravan_accepted.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_accepted.text: The road bends north-east. Two of them. And please bring back the cart in one piece — it is the only thing I own that has wheels.

caravan_active.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_active.text: Those thornhounds are still blocking the road. Clear them and come back.

caravan_intro.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_intro.text: Two thornhounds have made a den beside the road. My supply cart is stranded. Clear the road and I will pay you in goods, not just gratitude.

caravan_reward.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_reward.text: If you find anything else strange out there, tell me first. Information is lighter than cargo and twice as profitable.

caravan_turnin.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_turnin.text: The road is clear! You have saved my entire season. Here, take these supplies before I change my mind.

greet.speaker: Sera Quill
greet.text: A traveler with a real face! Buy something. Or don't. The mosslings are terrible customers and I am lonely.

news.speaker: Sera Quill
news.text: They say the Elder Hollow woke up. They also say the moon is a hole. I sell to both rumors equally.

shop.speaker: Sera Quill
shop.text: Glade sap, moonpetals, and one very stubborn charm that keeps finding its way back to my pocket. The shop proper opens once the caravan road is safe.

shop_greet.speaker: Sera Quill
shop_greet.text: The road is open, the cart is back, and I can finally sell without watching for thornhounds. Have a look at the stock. I promise the prices are only slightly insulting.

greet.speaker: Miller Ada
greet.text: The mill turns when the valley wind is kind. Lately the stream has carried pale petals from the old wood. I have never seen flowers drift against the current before.

lore.speaker: Miller Ada
lore.text: The Royal Road binds these places together. Each landmark is part of an older warding path, and the stones remember what the living have forgotten.

accepted.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
accepted.text: Follow the pale petals beyond the silver reeds. Do not strike at the light they carry; break the fear that holds it.

choices.text: I will return when they are free.

active.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
active.text: The sprites are still caught in the echo. Three must be calmed before the pool can speak again.

after_reward.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
after_reward.text: The Silver Pool is quiet again. When you are ready, follow the northern lights beyond the vale. The old world is larger than either of us imagined.

greet.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
greet.text: The water remembers the Matron, but it no longer trembles at her name. Something else is stirring below the silver lilies.

intro.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
intro.text: The moonpetal sprites have gathered around the deep water. They are not cruel, only caught in an echo. Calm three of them, and the pool may remember its own voice.

locked.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
locked.text: The Silver Pool is listening to a song that has not yet been finished. Return when Greenward's keeper has been freed.

choices.text: I will leave it in peace.

lore.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
lore.text: Before the roads were named, the pool held the moon's reflection for the whole vale. When the Matron bound the corruption, a fragment of that grief sank here. Now it is waking.

reward.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
reward.text: Take these moonpetals and the heart-fragment the sprites left behind. The Hollow is yours to walk without fear now.

choices.text: I am glad it is at peace.

turnin.speaker: Moonkeeper Liora
turnin.text: The water is clear. Listen — that is not the wind. It is the pool remembering the sound of its own name.

accepted.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
accepted.text: The road ahead will tell you what needs doing. Return when it is quiet.

active.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
active.text: The mosslings still block the road. Two will be enough.

after.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
after.text: The road is quiet now, but corruption gathers further east.

done.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
done.text: The castle gate stands ahead. May you not need what waits inside.

greet.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
greet.text: The royal road is overrun. Clear the mosslings before the next caravan arrives.

turnin.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
turnin.text: You made the road safe. Take this, and go onward.

greet.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
greet.text: The king's road is still safe as far as the windmill. Beyond the willow fields, keep your lantern close. The old forest has begun answering voices that no one speaks.

lore.speaker: Road Warden Elowen
lore.text: The Royal Road binds these places together. Each landmark is part of an older warding path, and the stones remember what the living have forgotten.

accepted.speaker: Royal Gardener
accepted.text: You will find them near the reflecting pools. Please be careful; they were built to protect this place.

active.speaker: Royal Gardener
active.text: The sentinels still haunt the pools. Defeat two of them, then come tell me the gardens are safe.

complete.speaker: Royal Gardener
complete.text: The promenade feels alive again. You have my gratitude, traveler.

choices.text: I will deal with the sentinels.

greet.speaker: Royal Gardener
greet.text: The gardens were made to be a place of peace. Lately, the old sentinels have stirred beneath their stone shells, and their eyes burn with a sickly light.

turnin.speaker: Royal Gardener
turnin.text: The garden is quiet again. The old stones can rest, and so can I. Please accept this small reward for your help.

greet.speaker: Scout Merrow
greet.text: The aqueduct is broken, but the water still runs beneath the stones. Something has nested in the arch. I marked a safe path through the rubble—follow the blue crystals, not the red ones.

lore.speaker: Scout Merrow
lore.text: The Royal Road binds these places together. Each landmark is part of an older warding path, and the stones remember what the living have forgotten.

greet.speaker: Tower Sentinel
greet.text: The spire is a lock, not a monument. Its violet light is the key turning in the wrong direction. Beyond it lies the sealed keep. I can open the way only when the tower's sigil is quiet.

lore.speaker: Tower Sentinel
lore.text: The Royal Road binds these places together. Each landmark is part of an older warding path, and the stones remember what the living have forgotten.

greet.speaker: Pip
greet.text: You can see the floating islands from here if you squint. My grandmother says they are pieces of a promise somebody broke.

lore.speaker: Pip
lore.text: The Whispering Glade. Greenward's oldest wound, dressed in flowers. Stay on the paths and you'll be fine. Mostly.

whispers_accepted.speaker: Pip
whispers_accepted.text: Listen for the soft chiming near the reeds. They hide when you get close, so keep your eyes open.

whispers_active.speaker: Pip
whispers_active.text: The three wisps are still out there. Follow the reed path and watch for their pale green light.

whispers_intro.speaker: Pip
whispers_intro.text: Three little lights keep calling travelers off the reed path. I think they are glade wisps, but they sound frightened. Could you quiet them before someone gets lost?

whispers_reward.speaker: Pip
whispers_reward.text: If you hear a fourth whisper, don't follow it. There are only supposed to be three.

whispers_turnin.speaker: Pip
whispers_turnin.text: The whispers stopped! I can hear the river again. Thank you. I found these near the reeds — maybe they belong to you.

greet.speaker: Élathra
greet.text: The gardens remember what the kingdom would rather forget, Kael. Will you hear what I have to tell you?

accepted.speaker: Élathra
accepted.text: Do not mistake the silence beyond the royal gate for peace. The war has left wounds that no sword can heal.

complete.speaker: Élathra
complete.text: Return to me when the road has revealed its secrets.
